# Product Catalog Development

This report presents the product catalog development for my Shopify practice store, **EverCharm**. The store focuses on handcrafted crystal bracelets and premium fashion bracelets. For this assignment, I expanded the product catalog, organized products into clear collections, and improved product information such as titles, descriptions, pricing, images, inventory, categories, tags, and vendor details.

# Product Description Quality

All product descriptions are written in a clear, informative, and customer-friendly style. Each description highlights the product's materials, design, craftsmanship, and suitable occasions, helping customers understand the features and value of the product. The descriptions also emphasize comfort, elegance, and gift suitability, making it easier for customers to make purchasing decisions.

# Assortment Strategy Reflection

The product assortment at **EverCharm** is designed to offer customers a variety of elegant and sophisticated bracelet styles while maintaining a consistent brand identity. The store includes two main collections: **Crystal Bracelets** and **Premium Bracelets**. Crystal Bracelets provide colorful and affordable options for everyday wear, while Premium Bracelets feature premium materials, refined craftsmanship, and timeless luxury-inspired designs for customers seeking a more sophisticated look. Together, these collections provide customers with a wider range of styles and price points while reinforcing EverCharm's commitment to elegant design, quality craftsmanship, and exceptional customer experience.

# CPP Farm Store Application Reflection

Creating the EverCharm product catalog helped me better understand the importance of product presentation in an online store. When I compared the **Crystal Bracelets** collection that I created last week with the **Premium Bracelets** collection I developed for this assignment, I realized that high-quality product photography makes a significant difference. The Crystal Bracelets used simple product photos, which looked much less professional and were less appealing to customers. In contrast, the Premium Bracelets featured high-quality images that created a more premium and attractive shopping experience. Therefore, I believe CPP Farm Store should use high-quality product photos, write clear and informative product descriptions, organize products into logical categories, and provide accurate pricing and inventory information. These improvements can make the online store look more professional and encourage customers to explore and purchase products.
